title: Nightsaber
wikitext:
[[image:nightsaber.png|thumb|]]

Large cat used as a primary [[mount]] for the [[Night_elf|Night Elves]]. The Nightsaber is similar in appearance to a real-world [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tiger tiger], but is black with white stripes or spotted like a [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cheetah cheetah] or [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leopard leopard]. The [[Frostsaber]] is a color variation of the Nightsaber - the [[Frostsaber]] is typically white with black stripes.


= Epic Mount =
[[image:EpicTiger.png|thumb|]]
The epic Tiger mount is bought in [[Darnassus]].  The PVP mount is the Black War Tiger.  A rare epic nightsaber is the [[Zulian Tiger]], a rare drop from a [[Zul'Gurub]] boss.
